rca_of_the_issue.bug_description: Appointments booked for a specific doctor (Dr. Neha Patel) did not appear in that doctor's portal
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Doctor name mismatch between staff collection (doctor_name field) and appointment records (doctor field)
rca_of_the_issue.fix_implemented: Ensured consistent doctor name 'Dr. Neha Patel' in: 1) staff collection doctor_name field, 2) DiaGyn.js doctors array, 3) appointment creation payload
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Created test appointment via API, verified it stores 'Dr. Neha Patel' and appears correctly when filtered in Doctor Portal
reproduction_steps: 1. Login as dr_neha to Doctor Portal
2. Book appointment through DiaGyn for Dr. Neha Patel at Pushpa Clinic
3. Check Doctor Portal - appointment should now appear (was missing before fix)
